events.name: KING OF THE NIGHT
events.details:
A decade ago Dracula, Lord of Vampires, faced Blade and the Sorceror Supreme in a climactic confrontation. Forced into a mystic slumber he has slept deep beneath New York while the world above changed. But now a mysterious benefactor reaches out across time and space, awakening the King of the Night once again.

This event requires Fear and Nightreaver characters at increasing power thresholds.

events.name: The Hunger
events.details:
Battle with the Undying team for brains with unique abilities.

Hunger Without End: Start with 10 brains and defeat enemies eating to satiate your hunger.

Hungry: +20% Speed and -8% damage per stack.

Satiated: +20% Damage, +10% Crit Chance, and +10% Crit Damage per stack. Eat your fill at 20 brains and become lethargic for a turn, then gain Undead Fortitude.

Undead Fortitude: Gain 50% damage resistance till the end of combat.
